title: Bull plasma proteomes at different seasons
projectDescription: Analysis of bull seminal plasma from different time points.
sampleProcessingProtocol: Samples were centrifuged and the supernatants were snap-frozen. Protein extraction was performed by mixing 1 Âµl of seminal plasma with 20 Âµl of SDS-PAGE sample buffer with DDT followed by a 10 minute incubation at 95 Â°C. Subsequently, iodoacetamide was added to a final concentration of 55 mM and the samples were incubated for 30 minutes in the dark. Samples were separated using SDS-PAGE until the front had migrated approximately 5 mm into the gel. Gel pieces were excised and washed before in-gel digestion with trypsin. The tryptic digests were cleaned using C18 columns.
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw data files were converted to mzML and MGF using ProteoWizard. MGF files were searched using MS-GF+ and X!Tandem against UniProt Bos taurus database as of 2019-04-03. Identifications were filtered in Proteios and matched to MS1 features extracted using Dinosaur. MS2 identitites were further propagated between runs in Proteios and data were exported as a peptide table with MS1 feature intensities.
